subject.title: refactor(config): retire legacy flat streaming keys to doctor-owned migration

question: Should the released flat-aware plugin SDK resolver semantics remain compatible while bundled runtime configuration becomes nested-only, or may this PR intentionally break third-party callers now?
rationale: Repository policy protects shipped external plugin APIs, while the PR’s recorded compatibility decision explicitly accepts startup rejection for persisted configs but does not clearly approve silently changing the released SDK resolver contract.

options.title: Retain SDK compatibility
options.body: Keep flat fallbacks in public SDK resolvers while removing flat reads from validated bundled runtime configuration and migrating persisted configs through doctor.

options.title: Use a versioned deprecation
options.body: Approve removal only with explicit plugin API documentation, compatibility tests, upgrade guidance, and a defined deprecation or version boundary.

options.title: Accept the immediate break
options.body: Explicitly accept third-party plugin breakage in this release and document the required caller migration before landing.

recommendation.title: Retain SDK compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep flat fallbacks in public SDK resolvers while removing flat reads from validated bundled runtime configuration and migrating persisted configs through doctor.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership of doctor compatibility and Discord streaming behavior, and the PR already records a maintainer-directed compatibility decision.
